workflows.name: Blog post to Telegram photo
workflows.description: Posts every published Blogger post to the Telegram channel set in TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: a photo with caption when the post has a usable image, otherwise a text message.

config.caption: {{trigger.body.title | default:"New post" | decode_entities | truncate:200 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.excerpt | strip_html | truncate:600 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.url | escape_html}}

config.text: {{trigger.body.title | default:"New post" | decode_entities | truncate:200 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.excerpt | strip_html | truncate:1500 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.url | escape_html}}
